analyst_view.overall: Marseille (4th, 18 points) have won five league games in a row under Bruno Genesio, while promoted Le Mans (16th, 8 points) are winless in five and have conceded in every league game. Genesio has a near-full squad: only Emerson (surgery during the break) and Cornelius are out, both counted, with Ulisses Garcia at left-back and Aguerd back to his best; he warns about Le Mans' two forwards running in behind and about counters after lost balls. Le Mans miss Bourabaa and Sidibé (counted), with captain Yohou expected to start in a back five. Marseille have a Europa League game on Thursday, and referee Eric Wattellier (3.5 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals and already take a large share off Le Mans for Bourabaa. Marseille are in form and nearly at full strength, while Genesio warns about Le Mans' counters and Thursday's European game may mean some game management once Marseille lead; these balance out, so I stay at 3.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.0 corners. Le Mans' back five and Marseille's narrow attacking midfield (Harit, Abdelli) are already in the numbers, so I stay at 8.0.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards and already take some off for Wattellier's lenient record. With no rivalry here and nothing pointing to a heated game, I stay at 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.9 shots. Le Mans look close to the strength the numbers expect and Marseille's line-up is near its usual one, so I stay at 25.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. Marseille's attack around Gouiri, Paixão and Harit is unchanged and scoring every week, which the numbers already show, so I stay at 9.4.
